name: Fighter
summary: Fighters share an unparalleled mastery with weapons and armor, and a thorough knowledge of the skills of combat. They are well acquainted with death, both meting it out and staring it defiantly in the face.
multiclassRequirement: You must have a Dexterity or Strength score of 13 or higher in order to multiclass in or out of this class.

hitPoints.Hit Points at Higher Levels: 1d10 (or 6) + your Constitution modifier per fighter level after 1st

spellcastingTable.title: You must have a Dexterity or Strength score of 13 or higher in order to multiclass in or out of this class.

journeyStages.summary: Class feature inventory with milestones and upgrades.

journeyStages.label: Fighting Style
journeyStages.summary: Choose the combat style that defines your baseline edge.

classFeatures.name: Fighting Style
keyFacts: Choose one fighting style option.
You can't take the same fighting style more than once.
classFeatures.summary: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the following options. You can't take a Fighting Style option more than once, even if you later get to choose again.

classFeatures.name: Martial Versatility
keyFacts: Optional fighter feature.
Lets you replace a known Fighting Style.
Only applies when you gain an Ability Score Improvement level.
classFeatures.summary: Whenever you reach a level in this class that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace a Fighting Style option you know with another eligible option from the fighter class.

classFeatures.name: Second Wind
keyFacts: Uses a bonus action.
Restores hit points equal to 1d10 + fighter level.
Refreshes on a short or long rest.
classFeatures.summary: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

classFeatures.name: Action Surge
keyFacts: Gives one additional action on your turn.
Refreshes on a short or long rest.
Becomes 2 uses at 17th level.
classFeatures.summary: Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again. Starting at 17th level, you can use it twice before a rest, but only once on the same turn.

milestones.label: 1 use per short or long rest
2 uses per short or long rest

classFeatures.name: Ability Score Improvement
keyFacts: Earn an ASI choice at specific fighter levels.
Increase one ability by 2 or two abilities by 1.
Can also trigger Martial Versatility if you use that optional rule.
classFeatures.summary: When you reach 4th level, and again at 6th, 8th, 12th, 14th, 16th, and 19th level, you can increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or you can increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. As normal, you can't increase an ability score above 20 using this feature. Whenever you reach a level in this class that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can also replace a Fighting Style option you know with another eligible option from the fighter class.

classFeatures.name: Extra Attack
keyFacts: Applies when you take the Attack action.
Starts at 2 attacks per Attack action.
Improves again at 11th and 20th level.
classFeatures.summary: Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. The number of attacks increases to three when you reach 11th level in this class and to four when you reach 20th level in this class.

classFeatures.name: Indomitable
keyFacts: Use after failing a saving throw.
You must keep the new roll.
Additional uses unlock at 13th and 17th level.
classFeatures.summary: Beginning at 9th level, you can reroll a saving throw that you fail. If you do so, you must use the new roll, and you can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest. You can use this feature twice between long rests starting at 13th level and three times between long rests starting at 17th level.

notes: Martial Versatility also appears as its own feature entry so creator and level-up flows can surface it explicitly.
